meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上后，请它做健康检查时：读取本地 LazyCodex/Codex 安装，比对最新源码，输出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告，每条附证据，且不改动你的配置或安装。
howto.when: 当你说“LazyCodex”、“omo-codex”等，或要求做健康/医生检查，或 Codex 在安装、更新、配置后行为异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 做个健康检查。
say.note: 会输出一份带证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告。

say.text: 我的 Codex 升级后行为有点怪，查一下。
say.note: 它会对照最新源码，指出差异并给出修复建议。

say.text: 对比我本地的 LazyCodex 和最新版差异。
say.note: 它会检查配置与插件，列出所有漂移项。

howto.what_en: Once installed, ask it for a health check: it reads the local LazyCodex/Codex installation, compares against the latest sources, outputs a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence per item, and does not modify your config or installation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'LazyCodex', 'omo-codex', etc., ask for a health/doctor check, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change.

say_en.text: Run a health check on my LazyCodex installation.
say_en.note: It will output a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence.

say_en.text: My Codex acts weird after an upgrade; look into it.
say_en.note: It compares against the latest source and suggests fixes.

say_en.text: Compare my local LazyCodex with the latest version.
say_en.note: It inspects config and plugins and lists any drift.
